content: Yoobu u mɑɑ win ɡɑri ɡerum wɔri u nɛɛ,

content.text: nɑ kĩ nɛn yellun wɑ̃ɑru tu wurɑmɑ
tɑ n sɑ̃ɑ nɡe sɑɑ ye Gusunɔ u mɑn kɔ̃su.
Nɑ kĩ nɑ n wɑ̃ɑ nɡe sɑɑ ye u fitilɑ sɔ̃re nɛn wuswɑɑɔ,
mɑ win yɑm bururɑm mɑn yɑm bururɑsie wɔ̃kuru.
Nɑ kĩ nɑ n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe sɑɑ yè sɔɔ nɑ dɑm mɔ,
mɑ Gusunɔ u mɑn kɔ̃su kɑ kĩru.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, Gusunɔ Dɑm kpuroɡii u kɑ mɑn wɑ̃ɑ,
mɑ nɛn bibɑ kɑ mɑn wɑ̃ɑ.
Mɛyɑ nɛn yɑɑ sɑbenu nu rɑ n bom yibɑ.
Mɛyɑ mɑɑ nɛn olifi yɑ rɑ mɑn ɡum wɛ̃ mu n kokumɔ nɡe dɑɑ kokɑ.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, nɑ̀ n yɑrɑ tɔɔwɔ nɑ dɑ nɑ sinɑ wuun ɡbɑ̃rɑrun kɔnnɔwɔ
su kɑ siri,
ɑluwɑɑsibɑ bɑ̀ n mɑn wɑ,
bɑ rɑ mɑn bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃wɑ bu doonɑ min di,
kpɑ durɔ tɔkɔnu nu se nu yɔ̃rɑ.
Tɔn bokobu bɑ̀ n mɑn wɑ bɑ rɑ ben ɡɑri ɡerubu yɔ̃rewɑ.
Mɛyɑ mɑɑ sinɑmbu bɑ rɑ nɔɔ mɑri,
kpɑ n sɑ̃ɑre ben yɑrɑ ben dɑro mɑni.
Wi u nɛn ɡɑri nuɑ u rɑ nɛɛwɑ, doo nɔɔruɡiiwɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ.
Wi u mɑɑ mɑn wɑ seedɑ ɡeɑ u rɑ mɑn diiye.
Domi nɑ rɑ wɔnwɔndo somi ù n somiru kɑnɑ,
kpɑ n ɡobeku wi bɑ yinɑ bu somi dɑm kɛ̃.
Be bɑ ɡɔɔ dɔɔ, bɑ rɑ mɑn domɑru kuewɑ.
Kpɑ n ɡɔminibu nukuru yɛmiɑsiɑ n de bɑ n nuku dobu mɔ ɡɔ̃ruɔ.
Gem kobu bu rɑ n mɑn wɑ̃ɑsiwɑ nɡe yɑbe te nɑ sebuɑ,
ǹ kun mɛ nɡe dɑwɑni ye nɑ bɔkuɑ.
Nɑ rɑ n sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɔ̃kobun nɔni,
kpɑ nɑ n sɑ̃ɑ kɔ̃ri kpiriruɡibun kɔ̃ri.
Nɑ kuɑ sɑ̃ɑrobun tundo.
Nɑ rɑ sɔbu nɔɔri, n ben ɡɑri mɛɛri yi bɑ kɑ nɑ.
Adɑmɑ nɑ rɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobun nɔsu bɔɔku,
n bu wɔrɑri ye bɑ mwɑ.
Mɑ nɑ tii sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɑ nɛɛ,
kon ɡbiwɑ tɔkɔru sɔɔ, nɛn kpin yeru wɔllɔ.
Nɛn wɑ̃ɑrun tɔ̃nu nu ko n dɑbiwɑ nɡe yɑni sɛɛri.
Ko nɑ n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe dɑ̃ɑ tèn ɡbini yi wɑ̃ɑ nim bɔkuɔ.
Kpɑ kɑkoru tɑ n wɑ̃ɑ nɛn kɑ̃ɑsin wɔllɔ.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, nɛn yiiko yɑ koo wurɑmɑ,
kpɑ nɑ n dɑm mɔ nɡe tɛn te bɑ ɡɑwe.
Yellu, tɔmbu bɑ rɑ yɔ̃rewɑ bu nɛn ɡɑri swɑɑ dɑki.
Bɑ rɑ nɔɔ mɑriwɑ bu nɛn bwisi nɔ.
Nɑ̀ n ɡɑri ɡeruɑ nɑ kpɑ, ɡoo ku rɑ mɑɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu wisi.
Nɛn ɡɑri yi, yi rɑ bu duuriwɑ kpurɛ kpurɛ nɡe nim mɛ mu dɑ̃ɑkumɔ.
Be kpuro bɑ rɑ n mɑn mɑrɑwɑ nɡe tom buruku ɡurɑ.
Kpɑ n yɛ̃ɛ musɛɛ n kɑ bu dɑm kɛ̃ sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ dɑm bie.
Bɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ bu mɑn nuki sɑnku n wuswɑɑ burisinɑ.
Nɛnɑ nɑ rɑ n bu swɑɑ ɡbiiye,
kpɑ nɑ n wɑ̃ɑ ben suunu sɔɔ nɡe sinɑ boko
wi u rɑ win tɔmbu nukuru yɛmiɑsie.
